name: FlashFolders
author: silverwings

sections.description:
FlashFolders improves the WordPress media library by making it easier to organize and browse media files.

The plugin adds a clean and intuitive interface that helps you manage large media libraries using virtual folders, allowing you to keep your files organized without changing how WordPress handles media attachments.

FlashFolders is designed for site owners, editors and developers who want better media organization with a fast and WordPress-native user experience.

Key features:
* Organize media files using virtual folders
* Browse large media libraries more efficiently
* Clean and WordPress-native admin interface
* No impact on existing media URLs
* Does not modify core WordPress behavior

FlashFolders works with standard WordPress attachments and integrates seamlessly into the WordPress admin area.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Media → Media Manager to start organizing your media files.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin change my media file URLs?

No. FlashFolders does not modify media URLs or file paths. It only adds an organizational layer on top of the existing media library.

Does it move files on the server?

No. Media folders are virtual and stored in the database. Your files remain untouched on the filesystem.

Is this plugin compatible with existing media libraries?

Yes. The plugin works with standard WordPress attachments and does not interfere with the default media library.

Is this plugin safe to use on production sites?

Yes. FlashFolders does not modify core files and follows WordPress best practices.
